_comment: Public cached endpoint index has the Go-owned executable identity and generation endpoints, with zero upstream I/O. CLI/index versions share one release build value.
name: m4_read_api_index
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"

[[models]]
name = "m-c"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
